title: The Survey
subtitle: the road north, walked and named
description: Thirteen stations from the gate to the master sheet, every one of
them named on the canvas, every one of them at least 132 pixels
from its named neighbour in the same row -- which is the spacing
the crowding check asks for when titles are drawn.
The chapter also answers to `the_map`, its alias: references written
against either name resolve the same way, which is what an alias is
for at every level of the format.
